status: stock-equivalent bridge: libraries/adas-link (Java, in Navigator, dry run) and tools/adas_bridge/stock.py (Python oracle), byte-identical; no live publisher

input.unknownPolicy: absent/null/availability unknown remain unknown; partial availability and issues retained

cuts: every known traffic light (the light ends its link)
tunnel, ferry and highway range boundaries
junction lane signs (point-scoped guidance, not continuous LaneNum)
geometry.length: haversine on WGS-84; link length cut down to whole metres (as Amap), segment = their sum (int navigationLen/groupLen/groupTime)
geometry.points: separate sequential slices per link with duplicated shared endpoints
geometry.sectionInstructionPhase: Yandex BEGIN entry action maps to preceding stock segment END at shared geometry boundary
geometry.trafficLightOwnership: the link ending at the light (within 1 m); a light at the route start belongs to no link but stays in trafficLights
geometry.finalArrival: MainAction 0, AssistantAction 36 only with known endpoint-consistent wayPoints
geometry.coordinates: transformed once, then rounded to the stock grid 1/3600000 (Coord2DInt32)

ids.linkId: SHA-256 of the link's own grid points, positive signed64: same road piece, same id in every route
ids.pathId: Amap-style per process: 100002 upward, one id per distinct link table (an identical table keeps its id)

candidate.unknowns: stock NULL values: roadclass/formway/linktype -1, ownership -1, actions 0; laneNum/direction/adminCode 0; never JSON null
candidate.profileFacts: link MainAction 0 and linktype 0 unless tunnel/ferry (stock route payloads); roundabout formway 4 direction 1; curLinkSpeed = section free-flow speed. Removed from local Java/Python source: highway/posted-speed class 0/6, divided/one-way/public assumptions and junction sign-width LaneNum. Highway/sign cuts and independently known graph fields remain; explicit known class 0/6 is allowed.
candidate.speedLimit: 0 on links (stock); TrafficInfo.SpdLmtSpeedValue = Yandex posted limit (onCurrentRoadSpeed)
candidate.actions: FORK/EXIT -> SlightLeft/Right 3/4; BOARD/LEAVE_FERRY -> assistant 19/20; WAYPOINT -> 0/35; arrival 0/36

guard.fix: FINE class only, timestamp newer than the last, at most 1000 ms old
guard.navigation: Navigator's own guidance state; loss, staleness and NOT_ON_ROUTE never end it
guard.finished: a finished routeId is retired for the process
guard.watchdog: no observation for 10 s ends navigation

validation.claim: the car golden is rebuilt from its PathInfo byte for byte (JSON, NaviDataDetail, native SOME/IP framing); Gson 2.10.1 and protobuf-java 3.25.5 agree
